answer: As of June 5, 2026, the RBI's policy repo rate was 5.25 per cent [6]. The Monetary Policy Committee voted unanimously to keep it unchanged at that level [6]. At its February 4-6, 2026 meeting, the MPC also kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25 per cent [4].
draft_answer: As of June 5, 2026, the RBI's policy repo rate was 5.25 per cent [6]. The Monetary Policy Committee voted unanimously to keep it unchanged at that level [6]. At its February 4-6, 2026 meeting, the MPC also kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25 per cent [4]. The sources do not state when the rate was last changed.
